# Hackathon material

Pitch and demo material from the hackathon build (YC RFS Fall 2026, *New Operating System for the Physical World*).
This material is kept for reference only and does not describe the current architecture. See `docs/architecture.md`
for that.

* `demo/physicsclay_demo.mp4`: the 2-minute demo video (generated by `scripts/make_video.py`). This 42 MB binary is
  slated to move to a GitHub release asset.
* `PITCH_SCRIPT.md`: the 5-minute pitch script.
* `pitch/`: stills used in the pitch.
